en.headline: HKEX renews CEO Bonnie Chan’s contract for three more years
en.dek: The board approved a new term running from March 2027 to February 2030; the Securities and Futures Commission has approved the reappointment.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited said on Monday that its board has approved the renewal of Chief Executive Bonnie Chan Yi-ting’s employment contract for a further three-year term from 1 March 2027 to 28 February 2030.
The Securities and Futures Commission has approved the reappointment under the Securities and Futures Ordinance, the exchange said.

Under the renewed contract, Chan’s basic annual salary is HK$12 million. She remains eligible for a performance-related discretionary bonus and share awards recommended by the remuneration committee and approved by the board.

Chan joined HKEX in January 2020 and became Group Chief Executive and an Executive Director in March 2024. She also serves on several board committees and holds related positions at HKEX subsidiaries.
The exchange said her term as a board and committee member will run in parallel with her chief executive appointment.

zh.headline: 港交所行政總裁陳翊庭獲續任三年至2030年
zh.dek: 董事會批准續約，任期由2027年3月1日至2030年2月28日，證監會已核准。
body: 香港交易及結算所有限公司今日宣布，董事會已批准與行政總裁陳翊庭就其出任集團行政總裁的合約續約三年，由2027年3月1日起至2030年2月28日。
根據《證券及期貨條例》，陳翊庭續任為港交所集團行政總裁已獲證券及期貨事務監察委員會核准。
續聘條款下，陳翊庭基本年薪為1,200萬港元，並合資格收取由薪酬委員會建議、經董事會批准的酌情表現花紅及股份獎授。
陳翊庭於2020年1月加入港交所，2024年3月起出任集團行政總裁兼執行董事，並擔任多個董事會委員會成員及附屬公司相關職位。
港交所表示，其於董事會及旗下委員會的任期將與行政總裁任期相同。
